kind.description:
Kind is "routine" (a routine's notify_me), "failure" (a run that failed,
needs a sign-in, or was missed) or "app" (about the app, e.g. an update).

urgent.description:
Urgent asks frontends to break through focus modes where the OS allows
(macOS time-sensitive, Linux critical urgency).

routine.description: Routine and Run (a run ID, as in `runs show`) are what it's about, if any.

open.description:
Open is a file the routine asked to open on click (instead of the
configured click action).

deliveredAt.description: DeliveredAt is when a frontend showed it; absent until then.

items.description: Notification is one thing to tell me.

title: Notifications
description: Written by the Go core, delivered by frontends: File is the notifications file: written by the core, read by frontends.
